en_title: Final Fantasy 14 Will Be The Biggest Game on Nintendo Switch 2 by Install Size, and Take Up Almost Half of the Console's Entire Memory
subtitle: 先腾出大片空间

paragraphs.en: Square Enix MMO Final Fantasy 14 will land on Switch 2 with an almighty thud next month, as its honking install size will take up almost half of the console's 256GB memory.
paragraphs.cn: 史克威尔艾尼克斯的MMO《最终幻想14》下月将以惊人的体量登陆Nintendo Switch 2（Switch 2）：其庞大的安装容量将占去这台主机256GB存储空间的近一半。

paragraphs.en: Final Fantasy 14 will weigh in at 117.2GB when it launches for Switch 2 on August 4, an eShop listing for the title has now revealed. Here's hoping you have space for it — or the budget to buy a new SD card.
paragraphs.cn: eShop页面现已显示，《最终幻想14》将于8月4日登陆Switch 2，安装容量为117.2GB。希望你的存储空间够用，或者有预算买一张新的SD卡。

paragraphs.en: That's around double the game's install size on PlayStation 5, which benefits from some clever file compression technology, though similar to the game's memory footprint on PC. It's a hefty download, though perhaps to be expected when you consider the MMO's size and the amount of content that has been added over the years.
paragraphs.cn: 这大约是该游戏PlayStation 5版安装容量的两倍；PlayStation 5版得益于一些巧妙的文件压缩技术，不过这一体积与PC版所需空间相近。下载量确实很大，但考虑到这款MMO的规模以及多年累积的内容，或许也在意料之中。

paragraphs.en: The upside to all this is that the filesize includes all of the game's previous five expansions — Heavensward, Stormblood, Shadowbringers, Endwalker and Dawntrail — so you won't need more space to play any of those. The downside? A sixth expansion, Evercold, is already on the way — meaning you'll likely need even more memory space from next January.
paragraphs.cn: 好消息是，这个文件体积已包含游戏此前五部资料片——Heavensward、Stormblood、Shadowbringers、Endwalker和Dawntrail——游玩其中任何一部都无需再腾出空间。坏消息是，第六部资料片Evercold已在路上，这意味着从明年1月起你可能还需要更多存储空间。

paragraphs.en: Somewhat amusingly, Final Fantasy publisher Square Enix is no stranger to holding the record for the biggest Switch 2 games by memory size. Until the launch of Final Fantasy 14, Square Enix's Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth holds the current record (91.8GB) for a single game, as well as the record for a game bundle (the Kingdom Hearts Collection, which includes a trio of titles that weigh in at 131GB total).
paragraphs.cn: 颇有意思的是，《最终幻想》发行商史克威尔艾尼克斯并不陌生于保持Switch 2游戏容量纪录。在《最终幻想14》推出前，史克威尔艾尼克斯的《最终幻想7 重生》以91.8GB保持单款游戏纪录；游戏合集纪录则属于《王国之心合集》，其中三款作品总计131GB。

paragraphs.en: Final Fantasy 14 game director Naoki Yoshida suited up in Bastion armor to take the stage at Final Fantasy 14 Fan Festival 2026 in Berlin to confirm the title's long-awaited Switch 2 launch date over the weekend, alongside a laundry list of new updates coming in the near future . The game's first month on sale will be offered without any subscription charge as its servers are stabilized. After this period comes to an end, players will be required to purchase a subscription as normal.
paragraphs.cn: 《最终幻想14》游戏总监吉田直树周末身着Bastion护甲登上柏林举行的《最终幻想14》2026粉丝节舞台，确认了玩家期待已久的Switch 2发售日期，并公布一长串即将到来的更新。游戏发售后的首月将免订阅费，以便稳定服务器；这一时期结束后，玩家将按惯例需要购买订阅。

summary: 《最终幻想14》将于8月4日登陆Switch 2，117.2GB的安装容量将占去256GB主机近半空间。文件已含五部资料片，但第六部资料片Evercold明年1月推出后，玩家还需更多空间。
opus_summary: Switch 2版《最终幻想14》以117.2GB刷新单作容量纪录；首月免订阅费，但未来资料片还会继续抬高存储需求，SD卡预算也得一并准备。
